title: Offline Mode and Map Data Strategy
note: browser frontend is spec-level, backend API tested
negative_results: Offline mode and the tile/terrain data strategy are delivered as a specification for the P58/P59 frontends; no browser or tile-bundling code ships in the pytest gate.
No cwatlas code, tests, or schemas were modified; docs only.
The app ships no default basemap; the tile source is operator-configured, and there is no baked-in provider.

claims.statement: The coordinate engine is basemap-independent: all coordinate operations run fully offline against a locally hosted P57 service; the basemap degrades to a graticule without breaking any result.
No private data leaves the device: coordinates, vectors, and receipts never enter an off-device request; tile requests carry only {z}/{x}/{y}; a fetch allowlist blocks all other origins.
No telemetry, analytics, or third-party CDN assets are enabled by default; exports pass export_separation.build_public_export / assert_export_clean and refuse records that scan as private.
A rendered basemap is a backdrop, not evidence; drawing a pin on imagery does not make a source vector's location real.

privacy_check: CLEAN - synthetic fixtures only, no private inputs
